mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses equity discount rates and drives capital allocation toward equities, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek yield in a low-rate environment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals severe labor market distress, triggering anticipatory policy stimulus and investor positioning for economic recovery, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, driving corporate revenue expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Low-inflation (CPIAUCSL 12m growth < 2.5%) and low-rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) regime indicates accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC for the joint signal falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals improving labor market health, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95 indicates manufacturing contraction, prompting anticipatory policy intervention and investor positioning for recovery, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Recessionary supply conditions (INDPRO < 90 and GDPC1 QoQ growth < 0) indicate economic contraction, triggering anticipatory fiscal stimulus and investor positioning for recovery, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC for the joint signal falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
